context_card.title: A free 30-minute call with a licensed adviser
content: Sort your cover. 30 minutes. A real adviser.
A few quick taps, then a licensed adviser's details and call times arrive on WhatsApp. No obligation.
SortMyCover is a service of Lead Velocity (Pty) Ltd. We connect you with authorised financial services providers. We do not give financial advice, compare products or quote premiums.

questions.label: Which age band are you in?
Roughly what monthly amount could you set aside for life cover?
Is a video, WhatsApp or phone call fine for your 30-minute chat?
Does your household have a bond or children at home?
questions._note: Pre-call brief only (1.1 ICP). Never disqualifies. If a separate bond and children split is wanted, add a second question; one tap is the default (fewer fields, Baymard).

questions._label_note: Meta prefills from the profile. Label shown to the user: Mobile number (WhatsApp). W02 runs the Twilio Lookup line-type check; landline/VoIP leads are not contacted.

_question_order_note: Qualifying questions come first and name/phone/consent last, so anyone routed out leaves before giving contact details or ticking consent (data minimisation). Do not add email, ID number, income, health or bank questions (2.1.3, 4.6).

custom_disclaimer.title: How we use your details

body.text: SortMyCover is a service of Lead Velocity (Pty) Ltd. We connect you with authorised financial services providers. We do not give financial advice, compare products or quote premiums. Privacy notice: sortmycover.co.za/privacy

checkboxes.text: I agree that Lead Velocity may share my details with {practice_name} (FSP {fsp_number}), an authorised financial services provider, who may contact me by WhatsApp or phone about life cover. I can opt out at any time by replying STOP. We also use your details in coded (hashed) form to measure and improve our ads on Facebook and Instagram. We never use them to send you ads by message.

_notes: Checkbox must be unticked by default (2.1.2). is_required true means the user cannot submit without ticking, which is what we want: no tick, no lead.
The markdown link in CONSENT-ADS-v1 is dropped here because checkbox text is plain; the privacy URL is in privacy_policy and in the disclaimer body.

W02 stores: the exact text above (as rendered, practice_name and fsp_number substituted), consent_text_version, consent_mode, form_id, leadgen_id, timestamp; sets consent_ads_at when the box is ticked.

thank_you_page.title: Thanks. Check WhatsApp.
thank_you_page.body: Check WhatsApp. Your adviser's details and times are on their way.
thank_you_page._note: URL is a placeholder: landing-page-builder to confirm the page exists; otherwise use https://sortmycover.co.za/. Never 'get a quote'.

conditional_logic_and_disqualifying_endi.status: Assumed UI-only. Configure in the form builder (conditional logic / custom ending). If Meta shows it as API-expressible, ads-api-engineer may move it into the create body.

routing_rules.otherwise: continue to name, phone, consent, then thank_you_page

conditional_logic_and_disqualifying_endi.evaluation_order: age_band, budget_band, call_ok (any one out-of-band routes out; no combination logic)

disqualified_ending.title: Thanks for your time
disqualified_ending.body: Based on your answers, a call with an adviser is not the right fit at the moment, so we have not shared your details with anyone. You can read more at sortmycover.co.za.

conditional_logic_and_disqualifying_endi.server_side_backstop: W02 re-checks every answer regardless of Meta routing. Any lead whose answers are out of band (or whose consent checkbox is missing) never enters the automation, gets no WhatsApp message, and its record is deleted within 24 h (2.1.7). Meta routing is for experience and Lead-event quality; W02 is the source of truth.
